styleLock.direction: clean everyday basics multipack tee commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless off-white studio sweep #F4F1E8 for figure frames, pale mist grey #E3E5E2 card field for the detail strip, soft forest-green gradient band reserved for the closing stack, no outdoor scenes, no lifestyle rooms
styleLock.lightingSystem: even high-key studio daylight near 5500K, broad soft key with feathered falloff, one fine shadow under each fabric fold to keep drape readable, never dramatic contrast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio paper, mist grey rounded info cards with thin drop shadows, folded cotton stacks on flat surfaces, no wood, no marble
styleLock.typography: one plain humanist sans in charcoal #232326, every feature label and headline slot kept as an empty underlined placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: none; the set carries no icon language, information rides on blank label rails only

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean everyday basics multipack tee ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of off-white studio #F4F1E8, forest green accent #3E5B4F, ink black shorts #232326 and pale mist grey #E3E5E2; even high-key studio daylight near 5500K with a broad soft key and one fine shadow under each fabric fold; seamless studio paper, mist grey rounded info cards and folded cotton stacks only, no wood, no marble, no outdoor scenes; one plain humanist sans in charcoal kept as empty underlined placeholder rails; no icon language; tees worn loose and untucked over plain black bike shorts with models cropped from the chin down; no color palette changes, no printed graphics, no face or identity, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底正身黑T（面孔完整入镜），一手捏下摆展示垂感，金坠项链与金耳环；002 灰蓝T背面全身（侧脸入镜），展示平直背片与落肩；003 四模特各穿紫灰/灰蓝/白/黑一字阶梯列（四张面孔均清晰）；004 白T提米色帆袋行走（面孔入镜）；005 三行圆角细节卡：Crew Neck/Loose Sleeves/Ultra Soft 英文字注（下划线标签位）。品类判定依据：主体为女式基础圆领短袖T恤四件装，L1 女装、L2 上衣，leaf 记基础圆领短袖T恤四件装，与提示类目一致；五图为正/背/色列/场景/细节卡分工，非色卡同构变体，正常转化。已剥离内容：品牌 Kinglaman 字样、全部模特面容（一律鼻下或下颌裁切）、三行英文字注原文（改为空下划线标签轨）、耳饰与项链不写品牌。与同品牌库内三套区隔：长袖套（俯视平铺+一主三副矩阵）、修身短袖套（抬臂卖点+场景快照）、oversize 套（紧绷痛点+五色斜列）均无本套的正背全身+四色人阵+三行圆角细节卡结构；色板改米白棚+森绿点缀+雾灰卡底，避开冷雾蓝/暖芥黄/雾粉水洗黑三系。源图 5 张，003 拆出四色人阵并新增折叠收口镜，按转化漏斗排为 6 镜。
